title: Concept for the provision of an infrastructure for the cross-sectoral, data protection-compliant "Secondary Use of Data" for Research and Science
summary: Data Nexus collects medical and personal data with the explicit written consent of patients for the processing and storage of individual patient data from various data sources in the UKD and from other healthcare facilities such as medical practices. It offers the use of data for patient-centred scientific studies to improve healthcare and patient outcomes

interventions.name: Data from patients with inflammatory rheumatic diseases is transferred to a Medical Dataspace and is then available for research.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Established or first diagnosed disease of the rheumatic type or clarification examination in the case of a suspected disease of the rheumatic type
- Sufficient knowledge of German
- Ability to give consent
- Signed declaration of consent for data transfer and data use in the Data Nexus application.
- Signed written consent for the processing of the evaluation data
- If the patients have already stored biomaterials in the RHINEVIT biobank or if the patients also consent to the donation of biomaterials to the RHINEVIT biobank separately to the Data Nexus consent on the consent day for their participation in Data Nexus: Presence of a consent form for the RHINEVIT biobank and presence of biomaterials and associated annotation data.
- Lack of consent for the RHINEVIT biobank is not an exclusion criterion for participation in Data Nexus.
Exclusion criteria:
- Age < 18 years
- Lack of German language skills
- Lack of capacity to consent
- Presence of a guardian
